text: Are you completely unable to pass any urine at all despite feeling the urge?
Did the inability to urinate start after an injury or trauma to the abdomen, pelvis, or back?
Is there blood visible in the urine?
Is the blood in the urine accompanied by clots, severe flank/back pain, or fever?
Have you had unintentional weight loss recently, or are you over 40 years old?
Is there pain or burning when you urinate, combined with fever, chills, or back/flank pain?
Has your blood pressure been very high (≥180/120 mmHg), and do you have a headache, blurred vision, or confusion right now?
Is your urine foamy or frothy, and do you have swelling in your legs, ankles, or face?
Do you notice bubbles or gas passing through the urine stream?
Did the loss of bladder control begin after a back injury, fall, or spinal problem?
Is there perineal or pelvic pain along with a slow or dribbling urine stream and fever?
Are you currently pregnant, or did this symptom start during or after a pregnancy?
Is there any discharge from the penis or vagina along with the urinary symptoms?
Does the symptom change depending on body position (e.g. leaking only when standing up or coughing)?
Do you have a known history of kidney stones, prostate problems, or bladder issues?
Is the skin around the groin or thighs red, sore, or broken down from urinary leakage?
Do you feel an urgent, uncontrollable need to urinate that is difficult to defer?
Have you had pelvic radiotherapy or chemotherapy for cancer in the past?
Have you noticed the urine being very pale or colourless, and are you drinking very large volumes of water?
How long have you had this urinary symptom? (days / weeks / months / years)
Do you have chronic high blood pressure or known kidney disease?
Has a recent surgical procedure or urethral catheterisation been performed?
Does the dribbling occur after you have fully finished urinating (post-void)?
